items.title: 67426_Hayes Pillars oral history interview
items.q: They issued a directive from MacArthur's office

ctx.x: And he said, " We're no blacks they didn't want us eating there. going to eat there." That was a set-up; (unintelligible). So we decided not to have a show. That's when they almost rioted, you know.

The G.I.'s almost rioted up there. So we got back in the trucks, we were riding in those big Army trucks, everybody had a little cushion, let's go back to Tokyo. That's what we did. The next day, hell popped loose. They issued a directive from MacArthur's office --
Stars and Stripes, all the newspapers.
